basis: Project-maintained developer-origin labels for the Free API, which omits country metadata. Exact creator names and explicit aliases only; unknown creators remain unclassified. API-supplied countries take precedence.
notes: These labels are a transparent project classification, not country metadata returned by the Free API.
Developer origin is separate from hosting location, legal domicile, ownership and deployment jurisdiction.
Use --tier pro for AA-supplied creator countries when your existing subscription supports it.
Update this registry explicitly for new or renamed creators. The program does not guess from model names.
